title: Latent Fact Composition under Next-Token Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.21921v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Controlled studies of latent two-hop reasoning train transformers to predict only the answer, whereas language models are trained to predict every token. We ask whether a model trained on every token learns to answer two-hop questions whose intermediate entity appears in no two-hop training example. We build a synthetic corpus with such questions. On this corpus every term of the loss can be computed exactly. A looped transformer, a standard transformer and DiscoLoop answer almost none of these questions. We therefore introduce the Baton family of looped transformers. They pass the intermediate entity to the second loop as a token embedding. When trained to predict only the answer, two of its three variants answer these questions almost perfectly. We then relate the success and failure of each model to three design conditions. Experiments that change one condition at a time agree with this hypothesis. When Baton is trained on every token

translated_title: 下一词元训练下的潜在事实组合
translated_abstract: 对潜在两跳推理的受控研究通常训练 Transformer 只预测最终答案，而语言模型则被训练来预测每一个词元。我们探究：在每一个词元上都进行训练的模型，能否学会回答那些中间实体从未出现在任何两跳训练样本中的两跳问题。我们构建了一个包含此类问题的合成语料库，在该语料库上损失函数的每一项都可以被精确计算。标准 Transformer、循环 Transformer 以及 DiscoLoop 几乎都无法回答这些问题。因此，我们提出了 Baton 系列循环 Transformer，它们将中间实体以词元嵌入的形式传递给第二次循环。当训练时只预测答案，其三个变体中有两个几乎完美地回答了这些问题。随后我们将每个模型的成功与失败归因于三个设计条件，每次只改变一个条件的实验结果与该假设一致。当 Baton 在每一个词元上进行训练时（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出 Baton 系列循环 Transformer，通过在第二次循环中将中间实体作为词元嵌入传递，使逐词元训练的模型能够回答中间实体从未在两跳训练样本中出现过的两跳推理问题，并归纳出决定各模型成败的三个设计条件。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the Baton family of looped transformers, which pass the intermediate entity to the second loop as a token embedding, enabling next-token-trained models to answer two-hop reasoning questions whose intermediate entity never appears in two-hop training examples, and identifies three design conditions that determine each model's success or failure.
